entries.title: Mark 7:1
segments: ¶Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes came together to Him, having come from Jerusalem.

entries.title: Mark 7:2
segments: Now when they saw some of His disciples eat bread with defiled, that is, with unwashed hands, they found fault.

entries.title: Mark 7:3
segments: For the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they wash [their] hands in a special way, holding the tradition of the elders.

entries.title: Mark 7:4
segments: [When they come] from the marketplace, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other things which they have received and hold, [like] the washing of cups, pitchers, copper vessels, and couches.

entries.title: Mark 7:5
segments: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked Him, "Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashed hands?"

entries.title: Mark 7:6
segments: He answered and said to them, "Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written: 'This people honors Me with [their] lips, But their heart is far from Me.

entries.title: Mark 7:7
segments: And in vain they worship Me, Teaching [as] doctrines the commandments of men.'

entries.title: Mark 7:8
segments: "For laying aside the commandment of God, you hold the tradition of men--the washing of pitchers and cups, and many other such things you do."

entries.title: Mark 7:9
segments: He said to them, "[All too] well you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

entries.title: Mark 7:10
segments: "For Moses said, 'Honor your father and your mother'; and, 'He who curses father or mother, let him be put to death.'

entries.title: Mark 7:11
segments: "But you say, 'If a man says to his father or mother, "Whatever profit you might have received from me [is] Corban"-' (that is, a gift [to God]),

entries.title: Mark 7:12
segments: "then you no longer let him do anything for his father or his mother,

entries.title: Mark 7:13
segments: "making the word of God of no effect through your tradition which you have handed down. And many such things you do."

entries.title: Mark 7:14
segments: When He had called all the multitude to [Himself], He said to them, "Hear Me, everyone, and understand:

entries.title: Mark 7:15
segments: "There is nothing that enters a man from outside which can defile him; but the things which come out of him, those are the things that defile a man.

entries.title: Mark 7:16
segments: "If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!"

entries.title: Mark 7:17
segments: When He had entered a house away from the crowd, His disciples asked Him concerning the parable.

entries.title: Mark 7:18
segments: So He said to them, "Are you thus without understanding also? Do you not perceive that whatever enters a man from outside cannot defile him,

entries.title: Mark 7:19
segments: "because it does not enter his heart but his stomach, and is eliminated, [thus] purifying all foods?"

entries.title: Mark 7:20
segments: And He said, "What comes out of a man, that defiles a man.

entries.title: Mark 7:21
segments: "For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,

entries.title: Mark 7:22
segments: "thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lewdness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness.

entries.title: Mark 7:23
segments: "All these evil things come from within and defile a man."

entries.title: Mark 7:24
segments: ¶From there He arose and went to the region of Tyre and Sidon. And He entered a house and wanted no one to know [it], but He could not be hidden.

entries.title: Mark 7:25
segments: For a woman whose young daughter had an unclean spirit heard about Him, and she came and fell at His feet.

entries.title: Mark 7:26
segments: The woman was a Greek, a Syro-Phoenician by birth, and she kept asking Him to cast the demon out of her daughter.

entries.title: Mark 7:27
segments: But Jesus said to her, "Let the children be filled first, for it is not good to take the children's bread and throw [it] to the little dogs."

entries.title: Mark 7:28
segments: And she answered and said to Him, "Yes, Lord, yet even the little dogs under the table eat from the children's crumbs."

entries.title: Mark 7:29
segments: Then He said to her, "For this saying go your way; the demon has gone out of your daughter."

entries.title: Mark 7:30
segments: And when she had come to her house, she found the demon gone out, and her daughter lying on the bed.

entries.title: Mark 7:31
segments: ¶Again, departing from the region of Tyre and Sidon, He came through the midst of the region of Decapolis to the Sea of Galilee.

entries.title: Mark 7:32
segments: Then they brought to Him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech, and they begged Him to put His hand on him.

entries.title: Mark 7:33
segments: And He took him aside from the multitude, and put His fingers in his ears, and He spat and touched his tongue.

entries.title: Mark 7:34
segments: Then, looking up to heaven, He sighed, and said to him, "Ephphatha," that is, "Be opened."

entries.title: Mark 7:35
segments: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was loosed, and he spoke plainly.

entries.title: Mark 7:36
segments: Then He commanded them that they should tell no one; but the more He commanded them, the more widely they proclaimed [it].

entries.title: Mark 7:37
segments: And they were astonished beyond measure, saying, "He has done all things well. He makes both the deaf to hear and the mute to speak."
